description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Awoken Scarlet Specialist Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Quick Cast] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Awoken Scarlet Specialist Mode
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts EM Shot after using after using Lightning abilities
